support-lucas: Hey team, opened a customer escalation — tenant `acme-corp` seeing a ~40m window of 502/504s on Hosted API (eu1). Started ~2024-11-05 10:02UTC, correlated with large embedding bursts. Customer timeline attached in ticket.

sre-ali: Thanks. Any trace ids or sample requests? Is this only for streaming endpoints or standard completion/embeds?

support-lucas: Mostly non-streaming embedding calls, batch size ~128, payloads ~1.5MB. One trace id from customer: `trace-4a7b9c`. Logs show upstream `envoy` returning 503 -> 502 then timeout. Dump below:

eng-matt: Paste the short curl that reproduces it please.

support-lucas: curl sample from customer (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","inputs":["..."],"batch_size":128}' \
  https://api.eu1.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Responses alternate between `502 Bad Gateway` and `504 Gateway Timeout` within the window.

sre-ali: Observed pattern: edge LB (frontdoor) bumped a priority failover rule after repeated conv failures -> traffic rerouted to lower-priority midproxy causing higher latency and then connection window exhaustion. I see `h2 stream window exhausted` in envoy metrics for that VIP.

julie.ops: @eng-matt can we see if the midproxy had any connection pooling/keepalive config changes yesterday? customer reports spike started right after their batch job kickoff.

eng-matt: Checking deploys — no env changes in that hour. But noticed a scheduled autoscaler event for dedicated pool scaling in us-west that might have increased cross-region fanout unexpectedly. Looking at `frontdoor` routing logs: many upstreams returned ECONNRESET on first attempt, then retries amplified.

sre-ali: Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) throttle customer batch_size to 32 via per-tenant rate limit, 2) enable client backoff and cut retries on envoys (set retry 0 for this tenant), 3) bump h2 initial window and connection pool for frontdoor VIPs temporarily. Which do we want to try first?

support-lucas: Customer agreed to reduce batch_size; trying that now. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy:scale-config frontdoor-h2-pool -> replicas +2 (initiated by julie.ops) :gear:

eng-matt: Also put a short-lived route policy: route `acme-corp` to eu1-primary only (disable failover) to avoid midproxy fanout for next 15m.

julie.ops: Doing route pin now. Patch in console -> pinned.

sre-ali: After reducing batch and pinning route, 10m window shows error rate dropped from 18% -> 0.8%. Latency tail improved. Metrics: env_conn_reset count fell, h2 window drain rate normalized.

support-lucas: Customer confirmed success and will keep batch_size=32 for the day. Ticket notes: follow-up actions: 1) add tenant-based batching suggestions to onboarding, 2) add automatic small-batch throttle when upstream resets spike, 3) revisit frontdoor h2 window defaults and retry policy by tenant. I'll file a runbook PR.

eng-matt: Agreed. I'll open an RFC to add tenant-level retry overrides and an automated circuit (short-circuit to primary VIP) for heavy-embeddings.

sre-ali: One more note: add an alert when per-tenant 502+504 spike >5% sustained for 5m, with hint to check `envoy.upstream_rq_5xx` and `envoy.h2_window_exhausted`.

support-lucas: Great. Closing slack thread. :white_check_mark:
